title: Expandable-blocks spike: probe document, form P (linear-plus)
note: Written through Linear's GraphQL API by the expandable-blocks spike harness. The record's URL is left out: it names the workspace.
sent_markdown: Expandable-blocks spike probe record — form P, Linear's documented collapsible form: `+++ `, the body, `+++`. Every block's summary starts `Probe :` and every body ends with the line `End of probe .`, so each block can be found again whether it renders collapsed or as literal text. Probes 01–06 vary the summary over a paragraph body; probes 07–13 vary the body under a plain summary. **What you should see:** Literal `+++` lines on GitHub and in a local preview; a collapsible section in Linear. +++ Probe P01: Plain summary text A paragraph with *emphasis* and [a link](https://github.com/nickderobertis/onetaskgraph-live-scratch) in probe P01.
